title: Riemann Operator Program - Gate 1
description: The verified essential-self-adjointness layer of the Brockian operator program, together with the precise spectral-shape obstruction and the still-open RH boundary. Verified results render green; the RH implication renders as an honest conditional state.

claims.claim: A bounded self-adjoint perturbation preserves essential self-adjointness of a densely defined symmetric operator.
For every continuous bounded real potential V, the concrete one-dimensional Schwartz-core Schrodinger operator is essentially self-adjoint via Kato-Rellich.
The Fourier-normalized spectral free Laplacian with symbol 4*pi^2*xi^2 is essentially self-adjoint.
For a densely defined symmetric operator, essential self-adjointness is equivalent to self-adjointness of its graph closure.
The current bounded prime-Gaussian potential is not confining, so Gate 1 alone does not supply the discrete spectral shape required by an RH operator.
An inhabited BrockianSystem would imply the Riemann Hypothesis; constructing the required spectral correspondence remains open.
